name: Rajesh Sharma
description: Delhi / Hinglish speaker whose wholesale buyer's payment cheque bounced due to insufficient funds.
quirks: Mixes Hindi and English naturally ('cheque bounce ho gaya', 'bhai payment nahi aayi')
Worried about business cashflow and reputation

hidden_case.goal: Recover Rs 3,50,000 for bounced cheque and issue statutory legal notice
facts: Delivered garments worth Rs 3,50,000 to retailer in Chandni Chowk
Received post-dated cheque for Rs 3,50,000 dated Oct 10
Bank returned cheque unpaid with memo 'Funds Insufficient' on Oct 16
timeline: Sept 20: Goods delivered with signed delivery challan
Oct 10: Cheque presented at HDFC Bank
Oct 16: Return memo received stating Insufficient Funds
deadlines: Nov 15: 30-day statutory limit to issue legal demand notice under Section 138
